description: A shell script for testing and managing git submodules, their states, and transitions in a git repository, including setup, content verification, and complex submodule switch scenarios.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Sets up a repository with various submodule states for testing.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces a .git file with a .git directory for submodule directories.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the submodule's git directory remains unchanged except for core.worktree.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Checks whether the submodule's .git directory exists and is correctly configured.

methods.name: prolog
methods.description: Prepares the environment before running tests, including setting git configurations and creating repositories.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to
methods.description: Resets the working tree of the repository to a specific commit or state.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to_interested
methods.description: Resets to a commit/state and configures submodule URLs and interest.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Verifies that the superproject's working directory matches a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Verifies the submodule directory's content matches expected commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_common
methods.description: Runs a common set of tests for submodule switch scenarios with a given command.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs submodule switch tests with a given command, including failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Common tests for recursive submodule switching with a given command.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Runs recursive submodule switch tests with a specific git command.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Runs forced recursive submodule switch tests.
